verdict.rationale: Ad blocking is a fair capability to ask of a browser-based crawler, so the axis applies. The pack never documents blocking ads or ad requests on target pages. Fit Markdown and BM25 filtering only remove noise from output after the page loads, so they do not speed up requests, and generic browser hooks are developer building blocks rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can block ads on the target page to speed up scraping requests
